Request reassigning "{{client}}" from {{from}} to {{to}}?

{{from}} keeps full access and its Duty Roster stays live until {{to}}'s Branch Manager accepts the move and chooses what happens to the existing duty roster.

activeProjects.confirmCloseOut:
Close out "{{client}}"?

It will move out of Active Projects and into Past Projects, and any guards still deployed here move back into the Guard Pool. Its value keeps counting in Pipeline Analysis as Won revenue — this only affects the Active Projects view.

If this contract is simply being renewed and work is continuing without a break, edit its Contract End date (and value, if the rate changed) instead — closing out will release its guards.

renewContract.title: Renew Contract
renewContract.intro: For a contract that's continuing straight through with no real break in work — extend its end date and, if the rate changed, its value. This is the same tender, not a new deal: it keeps its site, its guards, and its place in Past Projects history untouched.
renewContract.valueHint: Leave as-is if the rate isn't changing. Changing it logs a value-change entry in this tender's history, same as any other correction.
renewContract.errorEnterEndDate: Enter the new Contract End date.
renewContract.errorEndDateBeforeCurrent: New Contract End should be after the current end date ({{date}}) — this renews the contract, it doesn't shorten it.
renewContract.errorGenericRenew: Could not renew this contract. Please try again.

projectDetails.title: Project Details
projectDetails.siteModeQuestion: Does this project run out of a single worksite, or does it have more than one site/roster under this same contract?
projectDetails.siteModeHint: This is asked once — Multiple Sites adds a "+ Add Site" option below for linking more than one Duty Roster site to this same contract; Single Site keeps this form to just the one site's details.
projectDetails.locationPlaceholder: e.g. Menara ABC, Jalan Ampang, KL
projectDetails.scopeOfWorkPlaceholder: Summarize what the contract covers — posts, shifts, duties, etc.
projectDetails.clientAlias: Client Alias / Short Code (for invoice numbers)
projectDetails.clientAddressPlaceholder: Printed on invoices, if different from the worksite location above
projectDetails.guardRateHint: (optional — bills the client per man-hour worked, read live by the Duty Roster's Summary Report)
projectDetails.rateLastChanged: Rate last changed from RM {{from}} to RM {{to}} on {{date}} by {{name}}.
projectDetails.rateChangeAdds: Adds an estimated RM {{amount}} from this project's tracked contract value (assumes {{hours}} hrs/guard/month × {{guardsText}} × {{monthsText}} remaining).
projectDetails.rateChangeRemoves: Removes an estimated RM {{amount}} from this project's tracked contract value (assumes {{hours}} hrs/guard/month × {{guardsText}} × {{monthsText}} remaining).
projectDetails.additionalEquipmentHint: (optional — e-bikes, drones and similar, billed alongside guard headcount; add an item from day one of the contract or mid-way through it)
projectDetails.equipmentAddPreview: Adds an estimated RM {{value}} to this project's tracked contract value ({{monthsText}} remaining from {{start}} to contract end).
projectDetails.linkedSitesHint: (for a client with more than one worksite/roster under this same contract; each linked site gets its own Location, Guard Rate and Additional Equipment below, while the contract value above stays combined)
projectDetails.estMonthlyValueHint: (guard rate + active equipment, right now — a snapshot for reporting, not a split of the combined contract value above)
projectDetails.noSiteYet: This project doesn't have a Duty Roster site yet — open "Duty Roster" from Active Projects first to create its first site before linking a second one here.
projectDetails.managingBranchHint: Defaults to this project's own branch. Pick a different branch if this site will run under a different one — that branch will then manage this site's own Duty Roster, Guard Rate, and invoicing, without needing access to the rest of this project.
projectDetails.addSiteRequirementsHint: Site Name, Location, Contact Person, State, City and Postcode are required to add the site. Guard Rate and Additional Equipment are optional here and can also be changed later from the site's own card — set up its guards and roster from the Duty Roster tab whenever you're ready.

restRulesPanel.title: Rest rules
restRulesPanel.consecutiveDaysNote: = up to {{count}} consecutive working days before a rest day is due.
restRulesPanel.complianceModeDesc: Caps every guard at {{cap}}h/week (regular + OT combined) — the roster will leave a shift unfilled and flag it as a conflict rather than schedule a guard past the cap. This single number is set deliberately stricter than RBA (60h/week) and SMETA/ETI (48h regular, 60h combined) so it also satisfies Malaysia's Employment Act 45h/week limit, whichever framework a client site is being audited against.
